dinners.name: Peruvian-style garlic-cumin chicken thighs + aji verde
dinners.desc: Garlic-lime-cumin-smoked paprika marinated air-chilled thighs, broiled for char; cilantro-parmesan aji verde (jalapeño only in Rory's). Makes Monday's taco chicken.
dinners.side: Smoky roasted potatoes + lime green beans (small)

recipe.serves: 4 + ~600 g cooked chicken for Mon tacos. Bold but not spicy. The heat (jalapeño) goes only in Rory's aji verde.
recipe.time: 15 min prep + overnight-ish marinade · ~35 min at 425°F
ingredients: 4 lb (1.8 kg) organic air-chilled boneless skinless chicken thighs (→ ~1.3 kg cooked)

Marinade (mix Sat night or Sun morning, at least 2 hr): 25 g garlic (8 cloves) grated, 45 g lime juice (3 limes) + zest of 1, 30 g coconut aminos, 8 g (1 Tbsp) smoked paprika, 6 g (2 tsp) ground cumin, 2 g (1 tsp) dried oregano, 9 g (1½ tsp) kosher salt, 2 g (¾ tsp) black pepper, 10 g honey. No oil.

Aji verde (mild base, ~260 g): 170 g Greek yogurt, 30 g cilantro (stems ok), 15 g grated parmesan, 15 g lime juice, 1 garlic clove, 3 g salt. Blend smooth. **Rory's jar:** blend ⅓ of it with ½–1 jalapeño (seeds in for more heat).
700 g potatoes (ON HAND) in 1-in chunks, spray, ½ tsp salt, ½ tsp garlic powder, ½ tsp smoked paprika, ¼ tsp cumin
270 g green beans (Rory 120 · Wendy ~100 · Chloe ~50), spray, ⅓ tsp salt, lime zest
steps: 4:40 PM: oven to 425°F, 2 parchment-lined, sprayed half-sheet pans. Lay the thighs flat, scraping the marinade on top.
4:50: chicken in (upper + lower racks). Potatoes in the air fryer at 400°F for 20–22 min, shaking twice.
At 15 min, swap the pans. Bake 30–35 min total to 175°F, then broil 2–3 min for charred edges.
5:12: green beans in the air fryer at 400°F for 7–8 min, then lime zest.
Rory: 180 g chicken, 150 g potatoes, 120 g green beans, 40 g aji verde ≈ 560 cal / 54 g P. Reserve 600 g chicken + juices for Mon.

dinners.name: Pastor-style chicken tacos
dinners.desc: Sunday's chicken re-crisped in an ancho-pineapple glaze, charred pineapple, quick-pickled red onion, salsa verde, lime crema. Chloe's: chicken, pineapple, crema.

ingredients: 600 g leftover Peruvian chicken thighs, chopped
Pastor glaze: 60 g pineapple juice (from the pineapple), 15 g lime juice, 3 g (1 tsp) ancho chili powder (mild, smoky), 1 g cumin, 1 g oregano, 2 g garlic powder, 2 g salt
250 g fresh pineapple, diced small (½ pineapple; the rest is fruit for the week)
Quick-pickled red onion (make Sunday, ~150 g): 1 red onion (~150 g) sliced thin, 100 g apple cider vinegar, 50 g hot water, 6 g honey, 4 g salt. Jar, fridge, good 2 weeks.
10 small corn tortillas; 120 g jalapeño verde salsa (Rory and Wendy; Chloe skips); 15 g cilantro; lime wedges
Lime crema: 150 g Greek yogurt, 15 g lime juice, ¼ tsp zest, pinch of salt
Cucumber-tomato salad (~230 g): ½ English cucumber (~150 g) + 1 Roma (~90 g), diced, 10 g lime, ¼ tsp salt, chopped cilantro
Rory only: hot sauce or chipotle on the side
steps: 12-in stainless skillet, high heat, spray. Char the pineapple 4–5 min and set it aside. Add the chicken and glaze and toss 4–5 min, until sticky and 165°F with crisp edges.
Char the tortillas 30–45 s per side.
Build: crema, chicken, pineapple, pickled onion, salsa verde, cilantro. Chloe's: chicken, pineapple, crema.
Rory: 150 g chicken, 2 tortillas, 40 g pineapple, 20 g onion, 30 g salsa verde, 50 g crema, 100 g salad ≈ 500 cal / 44 g P.

dinners.name: Smash burgers
dinners.desc: Two 100 g grass-fed smash patties with a hard crust, caramelized onions, yogurt special sauce, lettuce, tomato, pickles on organic buns (Rory: ½ bun or lettuce wrap).

ingredients: 2 lb (907 g) organic grass-fed ground beef, 93% lean, divided into 100 g balls (Rory 2 · Wendy 2 · guest 2 · Chloe 1 · 2 for lunch); gelatin optional (1 tsp/3 g bloomed in 15 g broth, mixed in gently)
Smash seasoning: 6 g kosher salt, 2 g pepper, 2 g garlic powder, 2 g onion powder (sprinkle on after smashing)

Caramelized onions (~150 g): 2 yellow onions (~400 g) thin-sliced, spray, ½ tsp salt, 60 g bone broth added in splashes. 12-in skillet, medium, 20–25 min until deep golden; 1 tsp balsamic (on hand) at the end. Make Sunday, fridge.

Special sauce (~200 g, make Sunday): 120 g Greek yogurt, 30 g organic ketchup, 30 g minced dill pickles + 10 g brine, 10 g yellow mustard, 3 g smoked paprika, 2 g garlic powder, 1 g onion powder, pinch of salt
1 pack organic burger buns, toasted; 1 romaine heart (leaves for Rory's wrap option), 2 Roma tomatoes sliced, dill pickle chips; Grassmilk cheddar optional (not Rory's)

Zucchini fries: 2 medium zucchini (~400 g), spray, 12 g parmesan, 2 g garlic powder, 2 g smoked paprika, 1 g dried oregano, 1 g salt. Air fryer 400°F 10–12 min in 1 batch (or 425°F on a sheet 18–22 min, parmesan for the last 5 min). Dip in the special sauce.
steps: Fries first. Rewarm the onions.

Heat a stainless skillet or griddle over high for 4 min, spray. Add balls, smash hard to ¼ in with a sturdy spatula (parchment between), season. Cook 2–2½ min until a dark crust forms, flip, 1 min more (160°F). 3–4 per batch.
Build: toasted bun, sauce, lettuce, 2 patties, onions, pickles, tomato. Chloe: 1 patty, ketchup or sauce.
Rory: 2 × 100 g raw patties, ½ bun (30 g), 40 g onions, 40 g sauce, 50 g lettuce/tomato/pickle, 150 g fries ≈ 530 cal / 46 g P. Lettuce wrap ≈ 450 / 43 g.

dinners.name: Shawarma-spiced chicken kebabs
dinners.desc: Ground air-chilled chicken with cumin, coriander, paprika, allspice, cinnamon, lemon; charred under the broiler; garlicky toum-style yogurt. Aleppo on the side for Rory.
dinners.side: Bone broth rice + sumac tomato-red onion salad

ingredients: 2 lb (900 g) organic air-chilled ground chicken; 1 small onion (~100 g), 4 garlic cloves, ½ small red bell pepper (~60 g), 15 g parsley, all processed fine

Shawarma spice: 4 g (2 tsp) cumin, 3 g (1½ tsp) ground coriander, 4 g (1½ tsp) smoked paprika, 1 g (½ tsp) turmeric, 1 g (½ tsp) allspice, 0.5 g (¼ tsp) cinnamon (on hand), 8 g (1⅓ tsp) kosher salt, 1 g pepper; 32 g tomato paste; 15 g lemon juice + zest of ½ lemon. Spray, not oil. Aleppo (1 tsp) on Rory's at the table.
Toum-style garlic yogurt (~230 g): 200 g Greek yogurt, 3–4 garlic cloves grated to a paste with 3 g salt, 20 g lemon juice, 5 g honey (balances the raw garlic). Rest 15 min. Light, no oil emulsion.
Sumac salad (~180 g): 140 g cherry tomatoes quartered, 30 g red onion thin-sliced (from the red onion), 8 g parsley, 3 g sumac, 15 g lemon, salt and pepper
Rice: 450 g bone broth jasmine rice (frozen Sun, thawed Wed night), reheated with 2 Tbsp broth and a pinch of cumin
steps: Oven 425°F. Mix the chicken, aromatics, spice, paste and lemon. Spread ¾ in thick on a sprayed parchment half-sheet, score into 8 strips, dent with fingers.
Bake 18–20 min to 165°F, then broil 3 min until charred at the edges.
Make the toum yogurt and salad while it bakes; reheat the rice.
Rory: ¼ batch (~175 g cooked), 80 g rice, 80 g salad, 40 g toum yogurt ≈ 595 cal / 76 g P.

dinners.name: Miso-honey-ginger wild salmon
dinners.desc: Wild sockeye with a white miso-honey-ginger-lime glaze, air-fried to caramelized edges. Gochujang/hot sauce on the side for Rory.

recipe.time: 20 min, fresh). Gochujang/hot sauce on the side for Rory
ingredients: 1.5 lb (680 g) wild sockeye in 4 portions (Rory 180 g, Chloe ~85 g)
Glaze: 30 g white miso (on hand), 25 g honey, 15 g coconut aminos, 10 g fresh ginger grated, 1 garlic clove grated, 15 g lime juice, 3 g (½ tsp) toasted sesame oil (on hand)
Asparagus: 1 bunch (~340 g trimmed), spray, 1 garlic clove sliced, 3 g sesame oil, 4 g toasted sesame seeds, pinch of salt
450 g bone broth rice (frozen Sun, thawed Thu night) with 5 g sliced green onion (optional)
Rory only: hot sauce or 1 tsp gochujang stirred into 1 tsp honey on the side
steps: Pat the salmon dry and brush on ⅔ of the glaze. Let it sit 10 min.
Oven 425°F: asparagus on a parchment sheet, 8–10 min, then sesame seeds.
Air-fry the salmon at 400°F for 8–10 min (1 batch of 4 if it fits, else 2), brushing on the rest of the glaze at 6 min, until 145°F with caramelized edges (watch it; miso browns fast).
Rory: 180 g salmon, 120 g rice, 150 g asparagus ≈ 555 cal / 55 g P.

dinners.name: Rory's Mild Apple-Ginger Braised Chuck Roast
dinners.desc: Rory's ORIGINAL recipe at 1× for the 4 lb chuck on hand: 2 cups bone broth + ½ cup tamari (much less liquid than Oct 11). Oven first at 325°F, covered 4 hr.
dinners.side: Broth-yogurt mash + small shaved fennel-apple slaw

ingredients: 4 lb (1.8 kg) grass-fed chuck roast (or blade roast)
1 large apple, grated (Honeycrisp or Fuji, ~200 g / ~1 cup)
1 medium yellow onion, diced (~150 g)
4 garlic cloves, minced
1-inch piece fresh ginger, minced or grated (~1 Tbsp / 10 g)
2 Tbsp (42 g) honey
2 Tbsp (30 g) apple cider vinegar
**½ cup (120 g) low-sodium soy sauce or tamari**
**2 cups (480 g) beef bone broth**, the only broth. If using gelatin, bloom 1½ Tbsp (10 g) in ¼ cup of THIS measured broth, not extra.
1 Tbsp (14 g) toasted sesame oil (optional, but worth it)
1 Tbsp (16 g) tomato paste or 1 tsp (6 g) white miso (Rory usually uses both)
Salt (~1¼ tsp kosher) and black pepper (~¾ tsp)
Optional garnish: sliced green onion, toasted sesame seeds. Optional: 1 cinnamon stick + 1 star anise for the first 3 hours.
steps: **First thing (~1:00 PM for a 5:30 dinner):** oven to 325°F, rack low enough for the covered pot.
Pat the roast dry and season all sides with salt and pepper. Rory's house method: no sear, straight into his ceramic pot. (The original allows an optional sear in a little oil.)

Add the grated apple, onion, garlic, ginger, honey, vinegar, soy/tamari, broth, sesame oil, and tomato paste and/or miso (whisk the miso into a little of the broth). Turn the roast to coat it. Add the cinnamon/star anise now if using.
Cover tightly and braise 4 hours, undisturbed, until it shreds easily with two forks (~200–205°F). Pull the cinnamon/star anise at 3 hr.
Shred in the pot and toss it through the juices. If the sauce is thin, simmer uncovered on the stove (or in a stainless saucepan) for a few minutes to reduce.
Rory: 180 g beef with juices, 140 g mash, 100 g slaw ≈ 535 cal / 52 g P. Leftovers (~550 g + ½ cup juices) go in the fridge for next Monday.
recipe.scale: Uses the 4 lb chuck already in the freezer. Move it to the fridge **Wed night Oct 21** (about 3 days to thaw). Serves 4 + ~550 g shredded beef for next Monday. His original recipe is written for a 3–4 lb roast, so 4 lb is 1× with no scaling. The liquid stays at his original amounts, which is **much less than Oct 11**.
recipe.leftovers: ~550 g shredded beef + ½ cup juices, fridge, for next Monday.

Label every container with the dish, the day, the grams, and 'cooked 10/18'.
